turns.question: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, how much higher in EUR was the average non-cancelled order amount of customers who signed up before 2026 than that of customers who signed up in 2026?
turns.answer: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-10, customers who signed up before 2026 (the 2024 cohort) averaged EUR 102.67 per non-cancelled order versus EUR 41.00 for those who signed up in 2026, so about EUR 61.67 higher.
